description_en: Cap on the total number of WebSearch calls one session can make (default: 200). When Claude reaches the cap, further WebSearch calls return a notice telling it to continue with the information it already gathered. Accepts a positive whole number with no upper bound. Anything else is ignored and the default applies, so the cap can be raised but not turned off. Requires Claude Code v2.1.212 or later
description_ja: 1つのセッション内で実行可能なWeb検索呼び出しの総数を制限します。
use_case_ja:
- デフォルト値は200で、正の整数を指定して上限を引き上げることが可能です（上限なしへの無効化は不可）。
- メインの会話だけでなく、配下のサブエージェントが行う検索もすべて合計数にカウントされます。
- 上限に達すると検索は実行されず、既に収集した情報で継続するようClaudeに通知されます。
doc_snippets: A session can make at most 200 WebSearch calls, counted across the main conversation and every subagent it spawns, so searches made by parallel research fan-outs count against the same limit. The limit requires Claude Code v2.1.212 or later. When Claude reaches the limit, further calls a notice telling Claude to continue with the information it already gathered, rather than an error that would invite a retry. You don't see the notice: a capped call appears in the conversation as a search that did nothing, and if Claude genuinely needs more searches, the notice tells it to ask you to raise the limit. Set the CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION environment variable to change the cap; it accepts a positive whole number, so the cap can be raised but not turned off. Running /clear resets the count under the same rule as the session subagent limit . Write tool behavior
